scope: classtracker.py whole read and pinned blob verified; original selected classes exercised without starting background thread or constructor injection

control_result.scope: Exact AST classes, direct run with bounded callback and no-op sleep; actual Thread constructed but never started

findings: PeriodicThread.run resets stop=False on entry, discarding a preexisting stop request. Direct bounded run reproduces a snapshot despite prior stop, without live thread scheduling.
stop_periodic_snapshots uses deprecated isAlive; modern Thread class raises AttributeError. Reproduced on constructed but never-started original PeriodicThread.
Snapshot.total selects ProcessMemoryInfo.vsz when available, then asizeof_total, then tracked_total. These are distinct measurement domains; reproduced vsz100 selected over rss20.
snapshot_lock is class-level and shared across ClassTracker instances. Verified identity; this serializes snapshot calls but does not lock track_object/detach mutations or freeze application objects.

create_snapshot sorts tracked objects by birth for deterministic shared-reference attribution; source acknowledges shared-data ownership and asynchronous inconsistency limitations. No exact ownership or atomic snapshot proof.
History retains TrackedObject records and snapshots after object death, and keep=True intentionally retains strong object references. No history/sample cap; observer growth unbenchmarked.
track_object verifies weak reference before skipping an existing id, explicitly handling id reuse. Positive static property, not a file-content identity mechanism.

track_class injects constructor before original initialization completes; failed constructors can still leave lifetime tracking records. Detach restores saved constructor, without coordinating other trackers/instrumentation. No injection performed.
